nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.rationale: Satisfaction may exist inside one bounded Session, while pull is reserved for the space between Sessions so the current night never becomes harder to leave.

nodes.label: Behavior-Preserving Slice Workflow
nodes.rationale: Small approved slices, stable evidence hooks, independent artifact tests, and rendered inspection protect the supplied seed from an unverified rewrite.

nodes.label: Browser-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: The build extends the supplied Canvas demo and extracts modules only as approved slices touch behavior, avoiding a parallel rewrite while preserving a single source of truth.

nodes.label: Shared Session Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The portable HTML and installable PWA must be derived from the same Session implementation so public explanations cannot drift from shipped behavior.

nodes.label: Native Entitlement Deferral
nodes.rationale: Apple Family Controls entitlement, managed settings, distribution approval, and OS-specific behavior require a separate native proof track and cannot be claimed from a web build.

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.rationale: In-session satisfaction must never be used to prolong the current Session; invitation belongs only to a later return.

nodes.label: Respectful Punjabi and Indian Visual World
nodes.rationale: Specific contemporary material and landscape cues provide a grounded visual identity without generic exoticism, religious decoration, or implied language localization.
nodes.norm_label: respectful punjabi and indian visual world

nodes.label: Scullin et al. 2018
nodes.rationale: Supports optional specificity when naming an unfinished thing, while the product cannot claim the outcome of the studied writing task.

nodes.label: Harvey and Payne 2002
nodes.rationale: Supports one concrete procession rather than vague prompts, without treating the interactive Vista as the study protocol or insomnia treatment.

nodes.label: Hill et al. 2022
nodes.rationale: Supports targeting the intention-to-stop gap with a bounded path, not claiming that Nindova changes chronotype.

nodes.label: Brosnan et al. 2024
nodes.rationale: Supports the design focus on a hard stopping point while retaining the claim boundary that another screen also has costs.

nodes.label: Hartstein et al. 2022
nodes.rationale: Motivates real brightness decay and the 13+ positioning rather than marketing the product for young children's bedtime.

nodes.label: American College of Physicians Insomnia Guideline
nodes.rationale: Defines the clinical boundary: persistent sleep difficulty should be directed toward qualified care such as CBT-I, while Nindova does not diagnose or treat insomnia.
nodes.norm_label: american college of physicians insomnia guideline

nodes.label: M3 Deterministic Nights and Quiet Memory
nodes.norm_label: m3 deterministic nights and quiet memory

nodes.label: Hybrid Procedural and Illustrated Art Direction
nodes.rationale: Retain the responsive, asset-light procedural atmosphere while giving emotionally important focal objects and characters an authored illustrated finish.
nodes.norm_label: hybrid procedural and illustrated art direction

nodes.label: Procedural Ambience with Composed Accents
nodes.rationale: Keep continuous ambience adaptive and lightweight while composed closure accents establish a recognizable sonic identity.

nodes.label: User-Chosen Unguilted Wall
nodes.rationale: Preserve meaningful precommitment without repeated nagging, punitive blocking, or delegating the user's intent to a system schedule.

nodes.label: Asymmetric Vista Memory
nodes.rationale: Preserve continuity without turning return behavior into a countable collection or a loss condition.

nodes.label: Fifteen-Minute Session Cap
nodes.rationale: A final responsive light movement hands off to autonomous closure at the cap so continued touch cannot weaken the promise that the Session ends itself.

nodes.label: Portrait-First Session Design
nodes.rationale: Act-specific portrait compositions and semantic equivalents must precede interaction polish because uniform landscape shrinkage violates the phone-in-bed contract.

nodes.label: Browser and PWA Before iOS Wall
nodes.rationale: Family Controls entitlement risk and version-dependent Gate routing must not delay or weaken the browser-first experience.
nodes.norm_label: browser and pwa before ios wall

nodes.label: Separate Public Site and Session Artifact
nodes.rationale: A shared Session core can produce both a self-contained HTML artifact and an installable PWA without making the nightly experience depend on the site framework.
nodes.norm_label: separate public site and session artifact

nodes.label: Punjabi and Indian Visual World
nodes.rationale: Use material and environmental Punjabi and Indian craft cues while avoiding religious, nationalistic, generic exotic, or collage-like treatment; the theme must not alter behavior or accessibility.

nodes.label: M3 Deterministic Nights and Quiet Memory Checkpoint
nodes.norm_label: m3 deterministic nights and quiet memory checkpoint

nodes.label: M5 Website Docs and Offline PWA Evidence
nodes.norm_label: m5 website docs and offline pwa evidence

nodes.label: Installed Mobile PWA and Screen Reader Risk
nodes.norm_label: installed mobile pwa and screen reader risk

nodes.label: Two-Loop Law
nodes.rationale: Keep satisfaction and closure inside a Session while reserving curiosity and return pull for between Sessions; any mechanic that makes tonight harder to leave is a bug.

nodes.label: Behavioral Claim Boundary
nodes.rationale: Use behavioral earlier-stopping claims only, avoid sleep-performance language and clinical promises, and preserve the 13+ and CBT-I referral language.

nodes.label: Bourke et al. 2026 JAMA Pediatrics Study
nodes.norm_label: bourke et al. 2026 jama pediatrics study

nodes.label: Put the Next Thing Away Action
nodes.norm_label: put the next thing away action

nodes.label: Change Window to Mustard Meadow Action
nodes.norm_label: change window to mustard meadow action

nodes.label: Bounded Self-Closing Session Contract
nodes.rationale: A fixed portrait-first arc, monotonic closure, optional capabilities, and the absence of engagement mechanics protect the promise that tonight remains easy to leave.

nodes.label: Publication and Proof Boundary
nodes.rationale: A public repository and source implementation do not prove deployment, installed-device behavior, assistive-technology acceptance, a native Wall, a release, or an App Store build.

nodes.label: Observational and Asserted Test Split
nodes.rationale: The supplied observational script preserves evidence shape but does not establish success; the asserted arc is the regression gate before behavior changes.

nodes.label: Verified Source-Proven and Untested-Risk Evidence Levels
nodes.norm_label: verified source-proven and untested-risk evidence levels

nodes.label: Seed Observation and Arc Regression Baseline
nodes.rationale: Separating observational evidence from asserted state, copy, console, screenshot, and window.__ct checks prevents a logging-only script from being mistaken for a green regression gate.
nodes.norm_label: seed observation and arc regression baseline

nodes.label: Rendered Surface Requirement
nodes.rationale: A green source test alone is insufficient proof for an interface slice; phone and desktop surfaces must be inspected in rendered form.

nodes.label: Bounded Session Arc
nodes.rationale: The experience follows one fixed procession from arrival through closure so satisfaction stays inside a bounded Session.

nodes.label: Visible Set Closure
nodes.rationale: A small fixed set is put away completely before the Session moves on, preserving closure instead of interruption.

nodes.label: Zero-Score End Contract
nodes.rationale: The end card closes the experience without scores, streaks, tracking, or an obligation to return.

nodes.label: Production Fifteen-Minute Cap
nodes.rationale: Fifteen minutes is a hard ceiling; the Session can close naturally sooner and forcibly progresses toward its authored ending near the cap.

nodes.label: Production and Reviewer Boundary
nodes.rationale: Reviewer mode compresses timing for evidence while preserving the production path, state order, and terminal outcomes.

nodes.label: Monotonic Assistance
nodes.rationale: Snap radius, magnetism, shorter gesture distance, and autonomous help increase as the Session advances so completion becomes easier.

nodes.label: Non-Required Interaction
nodes.rationale: Touch, naming, guiding, and precision movement can enrich the Session, but autonomous transitions keep them from becoming completion requirements.

nodes.label: Quiet Tomorrow Intention
nodes.rationale: A voluntary return intention is stored locally without setting a reminder or creating attendance pressure.

nodes.label: Same-Origin Static Runtime
nodes.rationale: The installable runtime registers only a relative same-origin worker and loads relative static assets.

nodes.label: PWA and Standalone Separation
nodes.rationale: The installable HTTP build may register a worker, while the portable standalone removes install metadata and never registers one.

nodes.label: Optional Audio
nodes.rationale: Procedural atmosphere and authored accents enrich feedback, but state progression does not depend on hearing them.

nodes.label: Browser Evidence Contract
nodes.rationale: A stable debug surface exposes state, timing, assistance, local memory, Dawn, and controlled reviewer actions for deterministic browser evidence.

nodes.label: Fifteen-Minute Ceiling
nodes.rationale: Fifteen minutes is a maximum bound rather than a target duration; the production Session may close naturally sooner.

nodes.label: Graph Diagnostics Boundary
nodes.rationale: Dangling unresolved imports and undirected same-endpoint collapse are documented extraction limitations; zero missing endpoints and self-loops do not turn graph diagnostics into runtime proof.

nodes.label: Honest Release Boundary
nodes.rationale: Browser verification is reported separately from untested installed-device, assistive-technology, native, deployment, tag, and release claims.

nodes.label: No Release Claim
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint verifies readiness evidence but does not claim a deployment, tag, or release.
